name: Vulture

abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Dodge: Gelen bir temel saldırıdan veya temaslı özel saldırıdan geriye kaçarak kaçınma; Çeviklik ustalığı bu pencereyi genişletir.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Power Burn: Hedeften belirli miktarda güç alır, ardından alınan güçle orantılı doğrudan hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Siphon: Aktifken, rakibin herhangi bir yoldan kazandığı gücün belirtilen kısmını pasif olarak çalar.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.

howToPlay: Vulture için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Tech sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Thermal Reconfiguration
Vulture now begins the fight at full Chitauri Core Charge. Additionally, While the opponent is Incinerated, Vulture gains [0.7 - 1.88]% Max Power every .5 second(s).
immunityDetails:
• Yakma Bağışıklığı 🔥
• Zehir Bağışıklığı (ile sinerji: Ultron) 🧪
• Şok Bağışıklığı (ile sinerji: Kingpin) ⚡️

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: The Vulture's high-tech suit grants Immunity to Incinerate effects.
Gain an indefinite Armor Up Buff, increasing Armor Rating by [1,840.91]. If removed, this Buff will return after 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Chitauri Core Charge - Always Active
content: Either Champion Lands a Critical Hit: +10 Charge.
Vulture avoids a Debuff due to Immunity: +100 Charge.

abilitySections.title: Chitauri Core Charge - Exhaust Burn
content: While dashing back, Vulture cannot be struck by attacks.

If Vulture avoids an attack while dashing back in this way, he spends 10 Core Charge to grant a 100% chance to inflict a non-stacking Incinerate Debuff, causing [3,172] Energy Damage over 5 seconds. This effect also removes Perfect Block Chance and reduces Block Proficiency by 50%.

abilitySections.title: Chitauri Core Charge - Raptor Strike
content: To perform a Raptor Strike, launch a Medium Attack immediately after dashing back. Launching a Raptor Strike costs 40 Core Charge.
If the Raptor Strike Hits: Drain 50% of the opponent's current Power.
If the Raptor Strike is Blocked: Vulture gains a non-stacking indefinite Decoy Passive, which causes the next strike against him to Miss. Well-Timed Blocks will ignore the Decoy's Miss Chance.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Spend 25 Core Charge to grant a 100% chance to inflict an Armor Break Debuff, removing an Armor Up Buff and reducing Armor Rating by [964.29] for 30 seconds. Max Stacks: 5

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks 1 and 2
content: Vulture's Siphon Debuffs have 100% chance to trigger and they Passively Drain 25% of all Power the opponent gains from any source while they are active.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Inflict a Siphon Charge Debuff lasting 15 seconds. All Power Drained by this Debuff grants Core Charge proportional to the amount Drained. Ratio: 1 Bar = 45 Charge.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Inflict a Siphon Burn Debuff lasting 20 seconds. All Power Drained by this Debuff inflicts Direct Damage proportional to the amount lost. Ratio: 1 Bar = [8,326.5] Damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: This attack Incinerates the enemy, dealing [9,516] Energy Damage over 20 seconds. This effect also removes Perfect Block Chance and reduces Block Proficiency by 50% while it's active.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Thermal Reconfiguration
content: Vulture now begins the fight at full Chitauri Core Charge. Additionally, While the opponent is Incinerated, Vulture gains [0.7 - 1.88]% Max Power every .5 second(s).
